notes: Breadboard positions read from the circuit image: orange wire in 3b.g, resistor spanning 3b.h to 6b.h, LED anode (long, bent leg) in 6b.i and cathode in 8b.i, black wire in 8b.g.
The GND pin beside pin 13 on the digital header is mapped to GND.1; the catalogue does not say which of GND.1/2/3 it is.
The manual's text says the resistor goes to pin 13, the LED anode to the resistor and the cathode to GND, which matches the image and schematic.
No USB cable is included as a part. The manual only says to plug the board into the computer after building the circuit.
